verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਸਫਲ ਨਾਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ  ਚੰਦਨ ਮਿਲਤ ਸਭ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise jal mil dhrum safal naanaa prakaar  cha(n)dhan milat sabh cha(n)dhan subaas hai ||

en.bdb: Just as all trees and plants yield many types of fruits and flowers by their union with water, but the nearness with sandalwood makes the entire vegetation fragrant like sandalwood.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਵਕ ਢਰਤ ਪੁਨ ਸੋਈ ਧਾਤ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਰੂਪ ਕੰਚਨ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise mil paavak ddarat pun soiee dhaat paaras paras roop ka(n)chan prakaas hai ||

en.bdb: Just as union with fire melts many metals and on cooling remains the metal that it was, but when touched with philosopher's stone, that metal becomes gold.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਨਖਤ੍ਰ ਬਰਖਤ ਜਲ ਜਲ ਮਈ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਤਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਸਿੰਧ ਮਿਲ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਬਿਗਾਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: avar nakhatr barakhat jal jal miee savaiaa(n)t boo(n)dh si(n)dh mil mukataa bigaas hai ||

en.bdb: Just as rain falling outside the specific period (Nakshatra) according to the position of stars and planets is just falling of water drops, but when it rains during Swati Nakshatras, and a drop falls on the oyster in the sea, it becomes a pearl.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਪਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਅਉ ਨਿਵਿਰਤ ਜੋ ਸ੍ਵਭਾਵ ਦੋਊ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਅਭਿਆਸੁ ਹੈ ॥੬੦੩॥
verses.translit_en: taise paravirat aau nivirat jo savaibhaav dhouoo gur mil sa(n)saaree nira(n)kaaree abhiaas hai ||603||

en.bdb: Similarly, engrossed in maya and liberated of maya's influence are two tendencies in the world. But whatever intentions and inclinations one goes to the True Guru, he acquires the trait of worldly or divinely accordingly.  (603)
